blindDescriptions.System A: visionOS Home (visionOS 2 grid + dock): Single hero moment — huge tabular time (44-52px) + one widget, ultra-sparse 3xN app grid with 3D icon parallax, strong translucent glass scrims over blurred passthrough, dock/spotlight search, zero developer chrome in stage, focus via head gaze gives one unmistakable magnified halo, motion 220ms cubic-bezier(0.32,0.72,0,1) interruptible.
blindDescriptions.System B: Horizon OS Home (Quest): Dense shelf of flat opaque panels, small time in header, verbose labels, equal-weight cards with weak hierarchy, flat grey materials (no real translucency), linear 400-600ms spinner/loader, focus ring faint or duplicated across cards, edge states are afterthought spinners with no recovery CTAs.
blindDescriptions.System C: Artifact under review (Prism 02-home): Split hero — left 48px timecard (7:09 + date + 'San Francisco · Lens 82%') + right 146px weather card (72° + 'Partly bright · AQI 32' + embedded event pill 'Standup · 9:30 AM'), 4x2 launcher grid (8 apps with 46px icons, 12px label + 10px sublabel), horizontal 'Recents' scroll (4-5 cards, 124x88px with badges NEW/LIVE/12s/TEXT, mask fade right), bottom-center blue orb (56px radial gradient) with hover hint. Permanent top debug toolbar of 6 pills overlays hero. All built with /os/shared/design-system.css tokens (var(--mat-glass), --blur-glass, --ease-prism, --dur-base 260ms). Edge states via chip switching.

biggestGap: Control chip toolbar occlusion + focus theft: expected visionOS Home has zero developer chrome inside the 600x600 stage — time/launcher/recents/dock occupy 100% of space, edge-state triggers live outside stage (simulator chrome). Got components/02-home/index.html:35-45 .ctrl-row {position:absolute; top:48px; left:12px; right:12px; z-index:700; display:flex; gap:6px; justify-content:flex-end} renders six 26px pills (Home/Loading/Empty/Error/Offline/No access) permanently over the top 26px of content. Evidence reviews/probe-02-home/stage.png: blue 'Home' pill clips the timecard's top radius, 'Offline' pill clips '72°' text, 'No access' clips weather card; same overlap in stage-empty.png, stage-error.png, stage-offline.png, stage-permission.png. Steals glanceability (6 extra foci before time) and breaks focus discipline (blue active pill competes with bottom orb and 48px time for primary focus). Fix: move debug controls out of stage or into collapsible dev drawer; never overlay hero at 12px inset.
